findings.summary: Implementer report states "Tests for the change were written and run," but the diff touches only scripts/ingest.ts (no test file), and the repo has no test file for scripts/ingest.ts at all — before or after this change (confirmed via file search). vitest.config.ts only wires up the Workers-pool runtime (miniflare) for src/, which this Node-only operator script (execFile, mkdtemp, pdfjs-dist) isn't part of. The batching logic itself is correct on inspection, but the specific testing claim in the report is false as stated — no automated test exercises the new dual-cap flush behavior (string-count boundary, token-budget boundary, or the final partial-batch flush).
